correctness.rationale: The kernel equals (x-t)/[x(1-t)] for 0<t<x<1 and is bounded by 1, so the commutator is Hilbert–Schmidt. Both Jacobi systems are unitary images of complete weighted orthonormal polynomial systems. Terminating hypergeometric coefficient comparison gives the all-degree integration identity and exact T v_n=u_n/(n(n+1)); two ONBs yield the entire SVD. Exact telescoping/zeta sums, p-series test, and Volterra domination prove norms, ideal threshold and quasinilpotence. A standalone checker passed 44 rational convolution identities and 392 rational weighted-orthogonality checks. Finite checks are not infinite proof.
